purpose: Catalog organization for AI agents generating every kind of UI artifact from uidl-runtime JSON schema.
principles: JSON documents are the product source of truth; React code is host/runtime glue only.
Catalog entries must be reusable across projects, not tied to one reference company or route.
Use definitions/componentId/slots for reusable UI patterns before creating new primitives.
Separate visual family, pattern, data fixture, permission model, and export intent so agents can recombine them.
Every production-ready catalog item should have a parse/render smoke test and example dataSources.

recommendedTree.contains: AI-agent contracts, host integration rules, session/RBAC shape, validation gates, and output policies.
One file per visual family: website, dashboard, document, slide, spreadsheet, app-shell, mixed-suite.
Reusable pattern definitions such as hero, pricing, dashboard-shell, kpi-card, report-page, slide, workbook-sheet, RBAC nav.
Curated reference suites with scenario, audience, included documents, data fixtures, permissions, and verification points.
Renderable UIDLDocument examples. Drafts can live here until a future migration separates stable vs experimental references.
Optional shared datasets for references that should not inline all dataSources.
Future export adapter metadata for HTML/PDF/DOCX/PPTX/XLSX outputs.

notMigrated.reason: This file describes the catalog structure; it stays at the catalog root rather than nesting inside one of the folders it describes.
Mock API fixtures for host references/tests; out of scope for this migration, which only covers the four folders above.

promotionLevels.meaning: Representative example; can change freely; must parse/render before being referenced by tests.
Stable enough for references; has explicit session/data requirements and DOM smoke tests.
Public pattern contract; breaking changes require migration notes.
